_why: Lang keys of the elite world engine (bosses, calamities, chunk magicule, crystals) for the lead to merge into assets/nusmp/lang/en_us.json. The announcements and the item names of the calamities use translatableWithFallback, so the game works without them; the block, item and entity names and the other messages need these.
item.nusmp.magicule_gauge.tip: Hold it to read the magicule of the chunk you stand in. Use it for the exact numbers.
item.nusmp.calamity_core.tip: The heart of a fallen calamity.
item.nusmp.calamity_core.tip2: Use it on a Mother Rock with at least two charges to call the calamity back.
nusmp.elite.magicule.off: The magicule of this place is not being measured.
nusmp.elite.magicule.reading: Magicule %1$s%% (%2$s) | chunk %3$s, depth %4$s | crystals %5$s, Mother Rocks %6$s, ores turned %7$s
nusmp.elite.magicule.detail: stored %1$s, event %2$s, crystal score %3$s, Mother Rocks %4$s, ores turned %5$s, band %6$s
nusmp.elite.magicule.bumped: Magicule changed by %1$s in the chunks within %2$s of you; it fades back.
nusmp.elite.magicule.hud.title: Magicule Gauge
nusmp.elite.calamity.no_spot: No place to rise was found near you.
nusmp.elite.calamity.ritual_weak: The Mother Rock is too weak (charge %1$s of 3, it needs 2).
nusmp.elite.calamity.gravebound_colossus: The ground groans. Something old is climbing out of the graves.
The Colossus shudders, and the dead rise with it.
The Gravebound Colossus crumbles back into the earth.
nusmp.elite.calamity.lich_calamity.omen: The air turns cold and the magicule thickens. Somewhere a phylactery begins to hum.
nusmp.elite.calamity.lich_calamity.phase: The Lich's laughter echoes: its soul is no longer where you can reach it.
nusmp.elite.calamity.lich_calamity.defea: The Lich's phylacteries are dust, and its robes fall empty.
nusmp.elite.colossus.collapse: The ground will break! Get off the ground!
nusmp.elite.lich.nova: Death Nova! Take cover behind something solid!
nusmp.elite.lich.shield_broken: The last phylactery shatters, and the Lich's shield breaks!
